summary: ORIX Corporation filed a Form 6-K reporting that its consolidated subsidiary, Ubiteq, Inc., disclosed a difference between its standalone financial results for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026 versus the prior year. Ubiteq, listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market, reported net sales of ¥1,135 million (up 7.8%) and a swing to operating income of ¥57 million from a loss of ¥167 million. ORIX stated the impact on its consolidated earnings forecast is immaterial. This is a routine earnings-announcement notice under Rule 13a-16, not a special-situation event. What to watch: no deal terms or structural changes; purely informational.
